description: Send from an address this credential may send as. **To send later, pass `send_at`** (ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. `2026-11-04T09:00:00+01:00`): Pidgeon sends it at that time, even if you and the person are offline. Prefer this over scheduling a task on your side. It answers `status: scheduled` with a `cancel` call. Refused if the address’s send policy does not permit the recipient, or if the recipient previously bounced or reported mail as spam. When retrying a send, reuse its `idempotency_key` so it goes out once. A key with read-and-draft access is refused: use `create_draft` instead. **Read `status`**: `pending_approval` means nothing was sent — a person must approve it first — so do not send it again; check it with `get_draft_approval`.

data.description: Typed data: structured JSON sent beside the text, for software at the other end to read as fields. It is never mixed into the text.

body.description: The JSON fields. Up to 64 KB.

schema.description: A URL naming what `body` is, such as `https://schema.org/Invoice`.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: send_message
title: Send a message
